# PC muscles en SSH

PC Muscles over SSH keeps the brain in the cloud and borrows only CPU, RAM and disk from a Windows PC. Commands travel over SSH on a private network — never an internet-open port — with key authentication only and no local agent required on the PC. Part A installs the bridge and proves it works (OpenSSH Server, private-network link, dedicated key with strict permissions, key-only config, then a first simple command test with a verified host-key procedure). Part B customizes with the assistant's help: authorized jobs, hours, guardrails and a filled template the user validates. The user must be at the PC for the elevated prompt and the private-network sign-in, and the PC must be on and reachable or jobs wait. A revocation procedure cuts access cleanly. Honest note: this skill was built from a real installation whose bridge was proven; reproducing the bridge from scratch on a fresh PC is the remaining test.
